jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a dedicated operator to join their dynamic team in Pittem.

As an  operator, you will be responsible for the entire carrot processing process within your line.

You will ensure that the installation runs optimally and continuously monitor the quality and efficiency.

Your tasks will include:

• Checking incoming carrots and correctly storing them in the bunkers
• Operating, monitoring, and adjusting the machines responsible for the entire peeling process
• Continuously monitoring the production process and intervening where necessary
• Taking responsibility for the process until the grated carrots arrive in the production hall, where the further process is taken over by the team
The company cuts and packages fresh vegetables in an innovative way and produces creative ready-to-eat meal salads for the retail and food service sector. 

• A strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail
• Technically minded and able to monitor and adjust machines
• Fluent in English
• Experience as an operator or in a production environment is a plus

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do

• Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
• Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
• Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
• Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
• Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
• Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies. 

 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience

• Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
• 3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
• Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.
 

Technical Skills

• Data-Centric AI & Data Engineering: Data collection, labeling, curation, enrichment, feature engineering, data quality, feedback, and large-scale data processing. 
• AI & Fraud Analytics:
• Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning for anomaly and fraud detection, model evaluation, performance monitoring, and error analysis.
• Advanced Analytics: Graph analytics, network analytics, behavioral analytics, and financial crime analytics.
• Generative AI & Foundation Models: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, deep learning , transactional model and AI-driven fraud prevention solutions.
• Programming & AI Engineering: Advanced Python, software engineering best practices, AI application development and deployment, monitoring, and end-to-end AI lifecycle management. 
 

Soft Skills

• Analytical, proactive, and results-driven.
• Strong communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary teams.
• Comfortable in an international, fast-paced environment.
 

Languages

• Fluent English + Dutch or French (professional level).

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

Jobomschrijving

Employee Lifecycle Management:

Participate in the recruitment process: drafting and distributing job postings, pre-selecting applications, organizing interviews, and verifying references.

Draft employment contracts, amendments, and other HR documents.

Organize the onboarding of new employees: prepare administrative files, conduct welcome sessions, and monitor hiring formalities.

Ensure the update and management of personnel files in the HR management system.

Support employee departures: prepare exit documents and conduct exit interviews.

Skills Development:

Coordinate the logistical and administrative organization of training sessions and workshops.

Participate in the monitoring of the implementation of Personal Development Plans (PDP).

Maintain training records and monitor professional development actions.

Payroll Support:

Participate in the collection, verification, and transmission of payroll variable elements.

Answer employee questions regarding payroll, social benefits, and compensation policy.

Maintain accurate and compliant payroll records in a multi-country environment.

Employee Relations:

Provide a first level of response to employee inquiries.

Contribute to addressing first-level HR issues in collaboration with the Senior HR Manager.

Participate in the application and updating of HR policies and procedures.

HR Administration:

Ensure the management and update of HR databases and tools.

Prepare HR reports and statistics in line with the needs of the management.

Contribute to the organization of internal HR events (seminars, team building, etc.).

Perform any other administrative tasks assigned by the hierarchy.

Desired Profile:

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Social Law, Management, or Business Administration.

2 to 5 years of professional experience in a similar role.

Strong understanding of HR fundamentals (recruitment, personnel administration, training, payroll).

Knowledge of applicable social regulations.

Excellent proficiency in office tools (Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Proficiency in a Human Resource Management System (HRMS) is an advantage.

Professional level in French and English; proficiency in other languages is a plus.
